definition_de: hinter dem Horizont verschwinden (die Sonne geht unter); auch: im Wasser versinken (ein Schiff geht unter); übertragen: in der Menge / im Lärm untergehen (nicht bemerkt werden)
example_de: Wir saßen am Strand der Ostsee, bis die Sonne langsam im Meer unterging.
example_en: We sat on the Baltic Sea beach until the sun slowly set into the sea.
visual_idea: Most frequent collocation 'die Sonne geht unter': the sun half sunk below the sea horizon makes the downward direction of unter- visible; a couple in a Strandkorb anchors it in a German everyday scene. Sinking ship was less everyday, the figurative 'im Lärm untergehen' not picturable. Video shows the sun sinking (state: sun above horizon → half under).
image_prompt: seen from behind on a wide Baltic Sea beach in the evening, a couple sits close together in a white wicker beach chair facing the calm sea, the large orange sun is exactly half sunk below the flat sea horizon, a long golden reflection on the water leading toward them, deep orange and violet sky, a few gulls
